title: McpFeedbackRequest
description:
Deserialisation target for `tribal_feedback` input.

The `rating` field is a raw `String` so that invalid values (e.g. `"neutral"`) are caught during explicit validation rather than at the `serde_json::from_value` boundary.

embedding_profile_id.description: The `embedding_profile_id` from the discover response this feedback rates, carried back so the lineage records the profile that produced the results. Absent when the client does not echo it.
